headline: Adobe has filed patents for AI that could build explorable 3D worlds from a text description, but it has announced no product.
score_reason: Pool 5 lowered by 1: a patent filing is not a product, and Adobe has said nothing publicly.
importance_line: Game and design artists could eventually get faster ways to build 3D scenes, but companies file patents for many reasons and Adobe has made no commitment.
summary: Creative Bloq reports, citing the patent tracking site Patentlyze, that the US patent office has published Adobe filings including one for generating a navigable 3D environment from text such as 'a foggy Japanese garden at dusk', by first creating a 360-degree image and then 3D shapes from it. Creative Bloq stresses that a patent does not necessarily mean Adobe plans to build the tool.
